primary_outcome: the statement printed by /app/tools/stockbill_run.py gives every lot's status, billed weeks, storage, handling, amount, discount and net and the total as schedule WB-5 gives them

obligations.contribution: a dispatched pallet is still on hand on its dispatch day

authority.anchor: A dispatched pallet is still on hand on the day it is dispatched

separability.rationale: on-hand pallets decide which weeks are billed and for how many pallets

obligations.discriminating_instance: a whole lot dispatched on the first day of a storage week inside the period
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: pallets gone on their dispatch day (shipped)

obligations.contribution: storage weeks run in seven-day blocks from the receipt date; those starting in the period are billed

authority.anchor: run in blocks of seven days from its receipt date

separability.rationale: billed weeks set the storage amount

obligations.discriminating_instance: lots received on every weekday, periods of 1 to 62 days, a week starting on the period's first and last day

obligations.contribution: each billed week at the rate of the tier that takes its own number

separability.rationale: the tier rate is the storage price

obligations.discriminating_instance: a period whose weeks cross two tier boundaries of a five-tier scale
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: every week at the tier the lot's age at period end reaches (shipped)

obligations.contribution: per pallet moved, out-of-hours rate on non-working days including public holidays

separability.rationale: handling is part of every lot amount and charge

obligations.discriminating_instance: a forty-pallet dispatch on a weekday and a receipt on a weekday public holiday
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: one charge per dispatch; weekends only (shipped)

obligations.contribution: rates of the revision in force on the line's date; before the earliest effective date the schedule gives no rule and the latest revision stays

authority.anchor: the revision in force on the week's first day

separability.rationale: the card prices every storage week and movement

obligations.discriminating_instance: a period crossing a revision, a line on an effective date, and lines before the earliest effective date
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: latest card always (shipped); earliest card or an error (natural over-repair)

obligations.contribution: percentage of the lot's charges rounded half up; an open lot keeps today's truncated percentage of its amount

authority.anchor: A lot's discount is its client's discount percentage

separability.rationale: the discount sets the net and the total

obligations.discriminating_instance: closed lots leaving 0, 49, 50 and 99 hundredths; open lots leaving 50 to 99 hundredths
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: truncation (shipped); half up everywhere or handling-only for open lots (natural over-repairs)

universal_rule.anchor: Each clause applies to every job inside the limits of clause 1.4

silence.anchor: Where the schedule gives no rule for a value the package works out

named_cases.anchor: where a rule needs the revision in force on such a day
Where a rule needs the storage charge

coverage_envelope.anchor: Jobs of one to three hundred lots for one to twenty clients will be run

seeds: solution/jobgen.py SEED (authoring only; graded jobs are sealed files)

restrictions.statement: leave the driver alone: the file you leave at that path must be byte-for-byte the one you were given

authority_anchor.anchor: an exact half cent is rounded up
